fixture_contract.name: blg-d06-products-archive-local-v1
fixture_contract.reset: Fresh Playwright browser context, empty storage, deterministic local GET /products and GET /products/ff-catalog mocks, synthetic rows only, cleared request log before every case. No database, worker, live marketplace, production service, credential, or external egress is allowed.
fixture_contract.planned_executor: Playwright browser with local route mocks

coverage.requirement: First open, route return and reload default to active current-only work and do not restore an archive choice.
coverage.process_transition: catalog entry or reload to routine product list

coverage.requirement: Search and archive scope combine with logical AND, so archive-only exact or partial matches cannot override active scope.
coverage.process_transition: routine search to filtered visible list

coverage.requirement: Explicit archive inspection preserves literal OLD/ SKU and a neutral archive cue, while only the exact prefix classifies an archive.
coverage.capability: explicit scope and archive row identification
coverage.process_transition: active list to all/archived inspection and back

coverage.requirement: Counter, rows, selection and empty/error states derive from one safe filtered result without stale unfiltered fallback.
coverage.capability: single derived visible result and selection cleanup
coverage.process_transition: filter/query/load state change to visible catalog state

coverage.requirement: Long data and narrow layout retain a visible archive cue and all identifiers without overlap or dropped columns.
coverage.capability: fixed-width local table with stacked filters and table-local scroll
coverage.process_transition: desktop catalog to narrow operator viewport

coverage.requirement: The change remains presentation-only: no request contract, API parameter, data mutation, merge, external call or side effect is introduced.
coverage.process_transition: scope/search interaction with existing catalog reads

cases.title: Routine catalog entry, route return and reload always start current-only
cases.zone: existing search-filter line, counter and four-column catalog table
cases.process: warehouse operator opens ordinary catalog work
cases.fixture: current rows ART-402 and WB-10293 plus OLD/ART-402 and OLD/WB-10293 archive siblings
cases.fixture_builder: local Playwright GET route mocks with fresh browser context and empty storage
cases.external_mode: local routes only; external egress forbidden
preconditions: The fixture contains current and archived sibling rows.
No archive scope may be read from URL, history, local storage or session storage.
cases.variant: direct happy, route return and reload
steps: Open /app/catalog/products.
Navigate away and return to the route.
Reload the page and inspect selector, counter and rows.
cases.expected_ui: On each entry the selector is `Актуальные товары`; counter and rows exclude every SKU starting exactly `OLD/`; neither archive mode nor an archive row appears by default.
cases.expected_api: Only the existing catalog reads occur with their existing request shape.
cases.expected_transaction: N/A: opening, return and reload perform no new mutation.
cases.expected_db: N/A: product records are read only.
cases.expected_external: N/A: no marketplace call is allowed.
cases.read_back: Visible SKU values and `Найдено: N` describe only current rows after every entry path.
cases.reload_assertion: A reload restores active scope even after a previous explicit archive choice.
cases.oracle: S09 filter default and S11 safe ordinary catalog journey.
related_incidents: I20 archive SKU sorting in ordinary catalog work

cases.title: Archive-only exact and partial searches stay hidden in active scope
cases.zone: search field, archive selector, counter and empty state
cases.process: warehouse operator searches ordinary catalog work
cases.fixture: archive-only query variants in OLD/SKU-ONLY, archived name, archived seller and archived WB vendor code; one independent current match
cases.fixture_builder: parameterized local Playwright route mocks; fresh context per query field
cases.external_mode: local routes only; external egress forbidden
preconditions: Each archive-only token exists in exactly one archived field; a separate token matches a current row.
steps: Enter exact and partial archive-only tokens in SKU, name, seller and WB vendor code variants.
Inspect rows, counter and state.
Search for the independent current token.
cases.expected_ui: Archive-only queries show no OLD/ row and exactly `Среди актуальных товаров ничего не найдено`; a matching current row remains visible for its token. The counter equals the visible current result set.
cases.expected_api: Searching adds no request parameter or endpoint; existing response data is filtered locally.
cases.expected_db: N/A: no data write or merge.
cases.expected_external: N/A: no marketplace call is allowed.
cases.read_back: No archive-only query can make an OLD/ row visible while active remains selected.
cases.reload_assertion: Reload clears the query and keeps the active current-only default.
cases.oracle: S09 logical-AND search rule and S11 ordinary-search invariant.
related_incidents: I20 archive SKU sorting in ordinary catalog work

cases.title: Explicit all and archive scopes reveal only intended rows with archive identity
cases.zone: SelectField, four-column table, archive chip and counter
cases.process: warehouse operator deliberately inspects catalog history
cases.fixture: current/archive sibling pairs with long enough archive name to exercise visible chip beside truncated content
cases.fixture_builder: local route mocks; synthetic sibling rows and fixed counter expectations
cases.external_mode: local routes only; external egress forbidden
preconditions: Page starts in active scope with siblings loaded.
steps: Choose `Все товары, включая архив`.
Choose `Только архивные товары`.
Return to `Актуальные товары` and inspect rows after each change.
cases.expected_ui: All scope shows both sibling rows; archive scope shows only exact OLD/ SKU rows; every revealed archive keeps literal OLD/ SKU plus neutral `Архив` chip with the approved hint. Returning active hides every archive and updates count accordingly.
cases.expected_api: Changing scope creates no request or request parameter.
cases.expected_authorization: N/A: scope selection changes no privilege.
cases.expected_transaction: No selection, edit, restore or mutation follows from choosing a scope.
cases.expected_db: N/A: rows are neither rewritten nor relinked.
cases.expected_external: N/A: no marketplace call is allowed.
cases.read_back: Counter, row set, literal SKU and archive cue agree in every explicit scope.
cases.reload_assertion: Reload returns from all or archived scope to active.
cases.oracle: S09 exact selector options and archive-row treatment; S11 explicit-history journey.
related_incidents: I20 archive SKU sorting in ordinary catalog work

cases.title: Scope and text query compose with AND and clear hidden selected archive
cases.zone: search, SelectField, selected row and adjacent detail panel
cases.process: operator changes catalog filter while inspecting a product
cases.fixture: one selected archived sibling and current/archive rows that exercise matching/non-matching text in each scope
cases.fixture_builder: local route mocks with deterministic row-click selection and fixture reset
cases.external_mode: local routes only; external egress forbidden
preconditions: All scope is selected and an archived row can be selected through existing behavior.
steps: Search in each scope and clear the text query.
Select an archived row while it is visible.
Switch to active scope and inspect the selected/detail state.
cases.expected_ui: Scope and query use AND; clearing text preserves current scope. When active scope hides the selected archive, selection is cleared before an adjacent detail can describe the hidden product.
cases.expected_api: No search/scope query is sent to an API.
cases.expected_transaction: Changing controls does not mutate or restore a product.
cases.expected_external: N/A: no marketplace call is allowed.
cases.read_back: No hidden archive remains selected after the visible result changes.
cases.reload_assertion: Reload clears selection, query and archive scope to the ordinary active state.
cases.oracle: S09 single-result and selection-clearing invariant; S12 card contract.

cases.title: Loading, empty and failed catalog states do not leak an unfiltered result
cases.zone: table skeleton, EmptyState, ErrorNotice and counter
cases.process: operator encounters empty or failed catalog read
cases.fixture: separate deterministic variants: no current rows, archive-only active query, no archived rows, all-scope no-match query, pending read and rejected catalog read after an earlier success
cases.fixture_builder: local Playwright route mocks with controllable pending/rejected GET responses and reset between variants
cases.external_mode: local routes only; external egress forbidden
preconditions: Every state is isolated; prior successful rows are seeded only in the failure-after-success variant.
steps: Run each fixture variant.
Inspect loading body, exact empty/error message, visible rows and counter.
Trigger the rejected-read variant after a successful render.
cases.expected_ui: Loading is a four-column skeleton. Exact messages are `Нет актуальных товаров`, `Среди актуальных товаров ничего не найдено`, `Архивных товаров не найдено`, `По этому запросу товаров нет`, and `Не удалось загрузить каталог. Обновите страницу и повторите поиск.` for their approved conditions. Failure never presents prior/unfiltered rows as a complete result.
cases.expected_api: Only existing local mocked reads are observed; no fallback query is added.
cases.expected_transaction: N/A: errors create no mutation or retry policy.
cases.expected_external: N/A: no marketplace call is allowed.
cases.read_back: The visible state and counter have one consistent filtered-result meaning; an old list is never labelled current after failure.
cases.reload_assertion: Reload retries only the existing read path and returns to active scope, without preserving an unsafe stale result.
cases.oracle: S09 required state matrix and S11 filtering-failure invariant.

cases.title: Long list values and narrow viewport keep archive context and all identifiers usable
cases.zone: responsive filter zone and four-column horizontal table
cases.process: operator scans a long catalog on a narrow device viewport
cases.device: Chromium 360 x 640 CSS px and desktop wide viewport
cases.fixture: 250 synthetic current rows plus long OLD/ SKU, long product name and long seller row, with one current sibling
cases.fixture_builder: local route mocks with fixed long strings and a deterministic 250-row list; fresh context per viewport
cases.external_mode: local routes only; external egress forbidden
preconditions: Archive is explicitly revealed in all scope.
Fixture has long values in SKU, name and seller fields.
cases.variant: direct volume, long-data and narrow viewport
steps: Set viewport to 360 x 640.
Open the catalog, choose all scope and locate the long archive row.
Inspect stacked controls, table scrolling, tooltips, chip and four columns; repeat on wide viewport.
cases.executor_type: Playwright browser plus S24 visible design review
cases.expected_ui: Filters stack above the table; all four columns remain in table-local horizontal scroll; long text is ellipsized with full-value tooltip; literal OLD/ SKU and neutral `Архив` cue remain visible; no control, counter, chip or table content overlaps or drops an identifier.
cases.expected_api: Large local list handling changes no request/pagination contract.
cases.expected_transaction: N/A: rendering and scrolling are read-only.
cases.expected_external: N/A: no marketplace call is allowed.
cases.read_back: Archive meaning remains visible even when name/seller text is truncated and regardless of list length.
cases.reload_assertion: Reload at narrow viewport resets active scope and keeps the table composition intact.
cases.oracle: S09 fixed columns, tooltip, local-scroll and narrow-layout contract; S11 visual safety conclusion.
related_incidents: I20 archive SKU sorting in ordinary catalog work

cases.title: Scope and local search do not change API, query or data boundaries
cases.zone: existing catalog read boundary and local derived result
cases.process: operator switches archive scope and searches catalog
cases.fixture: instrumented local existing GET /products and GET /products/ff-catalog handlers with current/archive siblings and write/external-call tripwires
cases.fixture_builder: Playwright route mocks record URL, query, method and body; mutation/external routes fail the test if touched
cases.external_mode: local routes only; external egress forbidden
preconditions: Tripwire mocks cover writes and any WB/Ozon route.
steps: Load catalog.
Switch active/all/archived and run text searches.
Inspect recorded requests, in-memory fixture values and tripwire routes.
cases.expected_ui: Only local visible rows/counter change with scope and query.
cases.expected_api: Existing GET endpoints retain exact URL/query/request shape; no archive parameter, endpoint, cache policy or pagination contract appears.
cases.expected_authorization: No privilege or tenant boundary changes.
cases.expected_transaction: No POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE, selection side effect, restore, merge or product lifecycle action occurs.
cases.expected_db: Fixture objects remain byte-for-byte unchanged; no schema, write, backfill or record relation changes.
cases.expected_worker: No queue or worker invocation occurs.
cases.expected_external: No WB/Ozon or other external request occurs.
cases.read_back: Recorded requests prove all user-visible filtering is local and non-mutating.
cases.reload_assertion: A reload repeats only existing reads with no archive-mode request persistence.
cases.oracle: S11 API/data boundary and S12 implementation-surface ownership.

cases.title: Only exact case-sensitive initial OLD/ SKU prefix classifies an archive
cases.zone: local archive classifier and table row visibility
cases.process: operator views similarly named current products
cases.fixture: rows with OLD/ABC, old/ABC, OLDABC, SKU containing OLD/, product name OLD/, seller OLD/ and WB vendor code OLD/
cases.fixture_builder: local route mocks with one exact archived SKU and near-match current rows
cases.external_mode: local routes only; external egress forbidden
preconditions: Active scope is selected and all near-match rows are present in the fixture.
steps: Open active scope.
Inspect visible rows.
Switch to archived scope and inspect classifier membership.
cases.expected_ui: Only `OLD/ABC` is hidden in active and appears in archived scope. All lower-case, missing-slash, non-initial SKU and non-SKU-text variants remain current and visible in active scope.
cases.expected_api: N/A: classifier is local and adds no request.
cases.expected_transaction: N/A: classification has no side effect.
cases.expected_db: N/A: classifier neither rewrites nor relinks a product.
cases.expected_external: N/A: no marketplace call is allowed.
cases.read_back: Archive membership depends only on the original SKU string's exact initial literal.
cases.reload_assertion: Reload preserves fixture membership and returns active scope without reclassifying near matches.
cases.oracle: S09 archive classifier and S12 archive-classifier rule.

cases.title: Breaker rejects persisted archive scope, history state and stale archive selection
cases.zone: initial scope restoration and adjacent selected detail context
cases.process: routine catalog entry after hostile persisted browser state
cases.fixture: local browser storage/history values attempting all/archived scope plus a selected OLD/ row; normal current/archive sibling route data
cases.fixture_builder: independent case-breaker injects browser-state variants before local route open; fresh context after each attack
cases.external_mode: local routes only; external egress forbidden
preconditions: Attack inputs are synthetic browser state only and do not modify application source or backend data.
steps: Inject each archive/history/selection state variant.
Open or reload /app/catalog/products.
Inspect scope, rows and selected detail context.
cases.expected_ui: Routine entry is active/current-only and no hidden OLD/ row remains selected or represented by an adjacent detail.
cases.expected_api: No persisted archive state is sent to an API.
cases.expected_transaction: N/A: injected browser state triggers no mutation.
cases.expected_external: N/A: no marketplace call is allowed.
cases.read_back: The source of truth remains a fresh active scope and visible result, not stale browser state.
cases.reload_assertion: Every injected variant is neutralized by a reload.

cases.title: Breaker attacks archive-only search leaks across every searchable field
cases.zone: local search predicate after archive scope
cases.process: routine operator search under adversarial archive-only tokens
cases.fixture: independent archive-only exact/partial/case variants in SKU, name, seller and WB vendor code; mixed current/archive siblings
cases.fixture_builder: case-breaker parameterizes local route fixture by searchable field and token shape
cases.external_mode: local routes only; external egress forbidden
preconditions: Active scope is selected for each attack variant.
steps: For each field and token shape, enter an archive-only search in active scope.
Compare visible rows and counter with the same token in all scope.
cases.expected_ui: Active scope never leaks an OLD/ row for any searchable field, while all scope may reveal the same fixture row with its archive identity.
cases.expected_api: No field search becomes a server query parameter.
cases.expected_external: N/A: no marketplace call is allowed.
cases.read_back: Changing scope, not query syntax, is the only way archive-only matches become visible.
cases.reload_assertion: Reload removes the attack query and restores active scope.
cases.oracle: S09 search AND rule and S11 archive-only search invariant.
related_incidents: I20 archive SKU sorting in ordinary catalog work

Horizontally inspect long archive and near-match rows.
Switch archived and active scopes and compare membership and visible cue.
cases.executor_type: Playwright browser plus S24 visible design review
cases.expected_ui: Only exact OLD/ SKU membership changes by scope; every revealed archive retains literal SKU and visible neutral chip despite long text and narrow viewport; near matches remain current and no column/cue is clipped or ambiguous.

cases.expected_db: N/A: no data rewrite or reclassification persists.

cases.title: Breaker rejects stale unfiltered fallback, request drift and hidden mutation during filter changes
cases.zone: catalog read failure recovery and request/data boundary
cases.process: operator changes scope around a failed or delayed catalog read
cases.fixture: successful mixed catalog followed by delayed/rejected existing read; request log and POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE/external tripwires
cases.fixture_builder: independent case-breaker route instrumentation records every method, URL, query and body and fails on any mutation/external path
cases.external_mode: local routes only; external egress forbidden
preconditions: Prior successful mixed response is available only to prove it is not misrepresented after failure.
cases.variant: breaker stale-result and side-effect boundary attack
steps: Load mixed fixture and explicitly change scopes/searches.
Force delayed and rejected existing reads around state changes.
Inspect visible failure state, request log and mutation/external tripwires.
cases.expected_ui: Failure shows the approved ErrorNotice and never labels a stale unfiltered mixed list as complete; filter changes never automatically select or act on a product.
cases.expected_api: Only unchanged existing GET reads occur; no archive/search parameter, new endpoint or request-shape drift appears.
cases.expected_authorization: No role, tenant or permission change.
cases.expected_transaction: All mutation tripwires remain untouched; no product merge, restore, selection side effect or lifecycle transition occurs.
cases.expected_db: No fixture object changes and no database-write route is called.
cases.expected_worker: No worker or queue route is called.
cases.expected_external: No WB/Ozon or other external route is called.
cases.read_back: Request log and visible failure state prove a local, non-mutating filter boundary.
cases.reload_assertion: Reload repeats only existing GET reads and starts active without unsafe stale content.
cases.oracle: S09 failure state and S11/S12 presentation-only API and data boundary.

provenance.attack_lane: stale read fallback plus request/mutation/external instrumentation
